title: Fix feemarket MinGasPrice to prevent free EVM spam
summary: Set MinGasPrice from 0 to 1000000000 (10^9 astoc/gas = 0.001 ustoc/gas = 1 gwei). The v2-evm upgrade incorrectly set MinGasPrice=0, allowing EVM transactions with gasPrice=0 (free spam). This proposal sets a minimum matching the Cosmos-side min-gas-prices of 0.001 ustoc/gas.
